summary: Iteration 31: Proposal Restructuring Backend Testing. All 15/15 tests passed. Verified: Proposal CRUD with termos_gerais field, photo upload/list/delete endpoints, PDF generation (comercial vs tecnica), PDF content verification (plain text client info, numbered sections, TERMOS E CONDIÇÕES GERAIS section, OBSERVAÇÕES section), backward compatibility for proposals without termos_gerais, and dashboard functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Proposal CRUD correctly handles termos_gerais field in create, read, update operations (server.py lines 3363-3499)
Photo upload endpoint POST /api/proposals/{id}/upload-photo works with section_index query param (server.py lines 3512-3596)
Photo list endpoint GET /api/proposals/{id}/photos returns photos with id, section_index, storage_path (server.py lines 3598-3606)
Photo delete endpoint DELETE /api/proposals/{id}/photos/{photo_id} performs soft delete (server.py lines 3608-3616)
PDF generation fetches photos from DB via proposal_photos collection per section_index (server.py lines 3888-3900)
Commercial PDF shows plain text client info (no table), numbered sections with prices, VALOR TOTAL, TERMOS E CONDIÇÕES GERAIS, OBSERVAÇÕES
Technical PDF shows numbered sections WITHOUT prices, no VALOR TOTAL, but includes TERMOS E CONDIÇÕES GERAIS
Backward compatibility: proposals without termos_gerais return empty string
seed_data_creation: Test proposals created and cleaned up during backend tests (prefixed with TEST_)
